column10: No fossil comparator in Sacchi et al. (2023). The article's only conventional jet fuel cost is an input it takes from another study: "The cost of conventional jet fuel is assumed to be 0.50 €/kg, corresponding to the average production cost in 2019" (Methods, citing Becattini et al. 2021, who cite an International Energy Agency chart). It is a third party's 2019 cost, not one the study computes for 2030 or 2050.
